page.layout: One page of text, one column, running full width. Top: page number 410 at left, running head DESCRIPTIO at right. Below the text, at the right: catchword "Lace." Bottom left: faint show-through from the other side, not transcribed. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: dissuasore[?] fe, arbitrium liberum de hac permissum urbe fuerat, nunc totum id ab fe rejicere: respondisse enim legatis Lacedæmoniorum, rem[?] eorum ad fe nihil pertinere: cupere autem eos, qui nunc rerum Lacedæmone potissimum potiuntur, Achaicæ societatis & reipublicæ fieri participes, quorum desiderio si morem gesserimus, inquiebat, duo perquàm utilia nobis assequemur: nam tum eos nobis jungemus, qui semper Achæorum genti benevoli & fidi fuerunt, & deinceps ejus decreta probaturi & confirmaturi sunt, & pro accepto beneficio parem gratiam volentibus diis, nobis relaturi; tum cum veteribus exulibus, quorum ingratos atque impios animos experti sumus, sponte suâ urbe decessuris, & melioribus locum in ea daturis, in republicâ nihil habituri sumus commune. Verum obsistebat Diophanes, & qui cum eo faciebant, semper adversantes consiliis Lycortæ, & jam è vivis sublati Philo-pœmenis: monebantque Achæos, ne gratiam paucorum urgerent & prestitient etiam ipsi fortunam miserorum extorrium, qui contra jus & fas patriâ ejecti essent.

page.notes: Transcribed as printed, with long s modernised to s and u/v and i/j normalised. Ink blot over "rem" in line 3 (rem[?] is a guess). Ink blot over "re" and "Lacedæmoniorum⌣," (a small mark after the word, possibly a reference sign, not transcribed as a note). Word "dissuasore" at the first line is partly obscured by the page edge; the reading is doubtful. "prestitient" and "extorrium" are as read; "extorrium" may be a printing error for "extorrium" or "extorres", left as printed. The Greek-looking marks and blots in the left margin are page-edge damage and show-through, not text. Bottom-left show-through not transcribed.
